inputs.text: [excited] Listen to this true story. [serious] In the Mongolian desert, scientists found an incredible fossil: a Velociraptor and a Protoceratops, [pauses] frozen mid-fight.

[whispers] Yes. The raptor's claw stuck in the other one's neck, [slowly] and the other one biting down on its arm. [softly] A sand dune collapsed on top of them, and they stayed like that, together, for seventy-five million years.
